findings.title: codegraph freshness probe ensureFresh() correctly SKIPS sync when HEAD unchanged + tree clean — SEED-09's 3-4s tax is per-run Node+WASM boot, only paid when codegraph actually runs (not amortizable per-call by design)
findings.observe_how: Run two consecutive `node scripts/code-intel.mjs find-symbol X` on a clean tree; the intel-bus.jsonl duration_ms reflects Node+WASM boot, and freshnessInfo.synced should be empty (no sync) on the clean second run. Payoff: confirms the seeded tax is structural startup, closing the SEED-09 question rather than chasing a non-bug.

findings.title: SessionStart fans out 8 hooks with timeout ceilings summing to ~105s; real cost concentrated in session-start-docker (multiple execSync docker probes) + braintrust_hooks.py (cold python+httpx boot) — two interpreter boots at every session start
findings.observe_how: Time a fresh `claude` session start with hook stderr timing. session-start-docker runs `docker info`, `docker ps`, `docker inspect` via execSync (each its own process); braintrust_hooks.py pays a cold python interpreter + httpx import. The 105s is a ceiling sum, not actual — but docker-down or a cold python boot pushes wall time up materially.

findings.title: tldr-read-enforcer fires on EVERY Read >3KB (30s ceiling) and uses the TLDR daemon (in-process TCP) so cold-`tldr`-CLI is amortized — BUT the Windows reachability probe + queryDaemonSync spawn a per-Read subprocess (node -e probe; PowerShell socket bridge) even on the daemon-hit path
findings.observe_how: On Windows, each Read >3KB triggers tldr-read-enforcer -> queryDaemonSync, which calls isDaemonReachable() (spawnSync node -e TCP probe) then a PowerShell New-Object TcpClient for the actual query. Time a Read on a 5KB code file; the wall cost is ~2 child-process spawns even when the daemon is warm. The daemon removes tldr CLI cold-start but Windows reintroduces per-call process spawns.

coverage_manifest: D6b(a) uv-run startup on memory call (SEED-08): VERIFIED root cause — BGE daemon already amortizes the ~30s model load (recall_learnings.py:265-362); residual 13-17s is the `uv run python` interpreter boot + asyncpg/dotenv/pgvector imports, paid TWICE per prompt (checkLocalMemory line 151 + checkDbMemory line 225). No resident recall daemon; no recall result cache. A recall daemon mirroring embedding_daemon.py's TCP-rendezvous pattern could amortize it. -> D6b-01, D6b-02

D6b(b) codegraph freshness probe SKIPS sync when clean (SEED-09): VERIFIED — ensureFresh() scripts/code-intel.mjs:577-580 returns no-sync when HEAD==stamp && tree clean; probe is O(1) (cached gitHead + porcelain). The 3-4s is per-run Node+WASM boot, only on actual codegraph runs, not a freshness bug. -> D6b-03

D6b(c) SessionStart total budget: 8 hooks, timeout ceilings sum ~105s (ms values in settings.json). Real cost in session-start-docker (execSync docker info/ps/inspect, MAX_WAIT 10s) + braintrust_hooks.py (cold python+httpx). Two interpreter boots at session start. -> D6b-04

D6b(d) tldr CLI cold starts (tldr-context-inject / tldr-read-enforcer): VERIFIED both use the TLDR daemon (queryDaemonSync in-process TCP), NOT cold tldr CLI — daemon amortizes CLI cold-start. tldr-read-enforcer fires on every Read >3KB (30s ceiling). Windows residual: isDaemonReachable spawns node -e probe + queryDaemonSync uses PowerShell TcpClient = ~2 per-Read child spawns even on the warm-daemon path. -> D6b-05
notes:
READ-ONLY review at working tree (frozen SHA 86b8f60). No edits/tests run. All 5 findings VERIFIED by reading source.

SEED reconciliation:
- SEED-08 (warm hybrid recall 13-17s dominated by uv-run startup): CONFIRMED + root-caused. The dominant residual is NOT model load (daemon handles that, recall_learnings.py:265-362) but the `uv run python` PROCESS boot + Python stdlib/asyncpg/dotenv imports. NEW instance: this boot is paid TWICE per prompt (checkLocalMemory + checkDbMemory are separate spawnSync('uv') calls). The reusable fix is a resident recall daemon (embedding_daemon.py pattern). Did not re-discover the latency number; added the two-spawn root cause + daemon-reuse path.
- SEED-09 (codegraph 3-4s Node+WASM, amortized by freshness cache): CONFIRMED the freshness cache works as claimed — ensureFresh() does skip sync when clean. Logged as S3 document (closes the question; the tax is structural startup, not a bug). Severity matches seed.

Cross-link candidates (not duplicated — D-series findings on disk not read, but causal direction noted): D6b-01/D6b-04 share the systemic `uv run python` cold-boot pattern across hook lifecycles (memory hot path + session start). If a D2/D3 finding already names the uv-boot tax generically, these are the two concrete hot-path instances.

Telemetry surfaces that would prove/disprove each: memory-recall.jsonl (duration_ms) for D6b-01; intel-bus.jsonl (duration_ms) for D6b-03; hook-activity logs for D6b-04/D6b-05.

S3 cap usage: 1 of 5 (D6b-03 only). Well under cap.
